description: Run a website due diligence and counterparty risk report with seven live checks in one call: DNS and RDAP registration, domain age, TLS, page metadata, technology fingerprint, hosting context, OFAC name screening, and GLEIF legal-entity lookup. Hosting context carries no threat score and an OFAC name match requires human review. GET accepts scalar query parameters. For object or array inputs, pass the complete input object as JSON in the payload query parameter. Price: 0.04 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: DNS, RDAP.org, live TLS, public page metadata, transparent technology fingerprinting, IPWhoIs hosting context, U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list, and the GLEIF legal-entity register. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.
